dialogues.speaker: Leonie
dialogues.text: I can't believe we're already going back to Fontaine. I haven't seen nearly enough! The Korolevskiy Troupe's performance was simply wonderful. No matter how many times I come to Snezhnaya, it always leaves me wanting more...

dialogues.speaker: Emma
dialogues.text: It really does... Compared to the productions at the Opera Epiclese, it has a flavor of its own. It's truly fascinating.

dialogues.speaker: Leonie
dialogues.text: I knew it. Out of all my friends, you understand me best. Hey, when do you think we should come again? I can hardly wait to start planning our next trip...

dialogues.speaker: Emma
dialogues.text: Should we decide that now? But...

dialogues.speaker: Leonie
dialogues.text: What's wrong? You liked the performance too, didn't you? Or was there something about this trip that made you uncomfortable?

dialogues.speaker: Emma
dialogues.text: No, no, it's not that. The performance was wonderful, and I had a lovely time traveling with you. It's just... Dang it, this is so hard to say.

dialogues.speaker: Emma
dialogues.text: I'm only saying this because it's you... The truth is, I can't afford to take long trips this often. This trip used up quite a bit of my savings, and it's left me feeling rather uneasy.

dialogues.speaker: Emma
dialogues.text: You know, my uncle Estienne works at the Fortress of Meropide. According to him, there are many people there who went deep into debt because they spent beyond their means, and ended up having to go underwater...

dialogues.speaker: Leonie
dialogues.text: Good heavens, things like that actually happen...?

dialogues.speaker: Leonie
dialogues.text: But why would you worry about something like that? You have me. You're my irreplaceable dearest friend. How could I ever stand by and watch you fall into such a state?

dialogues.speaker: Leonie
dialogues.text: And the travel expenses too... You should have told me sooner, I could cover them for you. In fact, why don't you leave the cost of our next trip to me...

dialogues.speaker: Emma
dialogues.text: Oh! You’re far too kind, but that's not what I meant...
